text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—So, Journey. Where are we going next 
Tuesday?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Pardon me, but what are you talking 
about?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My apologies if my memory fails me. I 
don't recall making any particular 
promises...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Don't look so grim. It's fine, 
you're right. —After all, we never made a 
promise.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
So, Journey. What should we do on Tuesday? 
Highlands, mines, wetlands... Across the 
sea sounds nice too.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ............ I yield. It's my loss, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me your objective. Naturally, 
I understand that you are a free spirit, 
but... I would at least like to know the 
reasoning behind your statement.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Hm? Ah, I see. That won't do, then. 
Yeah, in that case—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Journey. Your present is a 
delightful trip.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I want to celebrate your day properly. You 
understand, right?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
......Fufufu... Well, well, thank you very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, Tuesday is a weekday, Big Sis. 
...I shall submit the application first, 
and we can discuss the details at our 
leisure afterwards.
